sentences.cs: Toto je příběh o Michalovi, který pracuje v restauraci.
sentences.en: This is a story about Michal, who works in a restaurant.

sentences.cs: Michal vstává každé ráno v šest hodin.
sentences.en: Michal gets up every morning at six o'clock.
He makes breakfast and drinks coffee.
He drives to work in his car.

sentences.cs: Jeho práce začíná v půl osmé.
sentences.en: His work starts at half past seven.
Michal is a cook in a restaurant.
He makes food for hungry customers.
The restaurant is always full of people.

sentences.cs: Michal vaří polévku, maso a zeleninu.
sentences.en: Michal cooks soup, meat and vegetables.

sentences.cs: Jeho kolega Petr dělá sladké dezerty.
sentences.en: His colleague Petr makes sweet desserts.
In the afternoon they drink a small coffee together.
In the evening Michal is very tired.

sentences.cs: Doma čte knihu a dívá se na televizi.
sentences.en: At home he reads a book and watches television.
At ten o'clock he goes to bed.
